requirements.claim: The implementation can identify the authority under which an action or registry assertion is evaluated.
The implementation can represent delegated authority without treating delegation as equivalent to identity.
The implementation can evaluate whether a requested effect remains within the authority or delegation scope.
The implementation can distinguish current, revoked, superseded, or otherwise non-current relationship or registry state.
The implementation can bind a conformance decision to inspectable evidence and preserve missing evidence as non-success.

invariants: missing required evidence MUST NOT become PASS
unknown semantic identifiers MUST NOT become PASS
unsupported profile or TSMM versions MUST NOT become PASS
revoked or non-current authority state MUST NOT become PASS
